map.由质量数求核半径 使用指南: Deriving the Nuclear Radius from the Mass Number User Guide
map.输入原子核质量数 A，按 R = r₀·A^{1/3}（r₀≈1.2 fm）估算: Enter the nuclear mass number A and estimate the nuclear radius as R = r_0 x A^(1/3) (r_0 about 1.2 fm), used for nuclear physics teaching and for nuclear size and density estimates.
map.输入质量数 A，求原子核半径（r₀=1.2 fm）。: Enter the mass number A to find the nuclear radius (r_0 = 1.2 fm).
map.R = r₀·A^(1/3)，r₀≈1.2fm，由质量数 A 求核半径。: R = r_0 x A^(1/3), with r_0 about 1.2 fm, giving the nuclear radius from mass number A.
map.核密度、核反应截面估算。: Nuclear density and nuclear reaction cross-section estimation.
map.对比不同 A 的核尺寸。: Compare nuclear sizes for different A.
map.：若 A=208（Pb），则 R≈1.2e-15×5.92≈7.1 fm，核尺寸: With A=208 (Pb), R is about 1.2e-15 x 5.92 = 7.1 fm, so nuclear size grows slowly as the cube root of A.
map.由中子通量、截面与靶核数求反应率: Reaction rate from neutron flux, cross-section and target nucleus count
map.核体积与 A 成正比？: Is nuclear volume proportional to A?
map.是，R∝A^(1/3) 故体积∝A，核密度近似常数，这是液滴模型基础。: Yes, since R scales as A^(1/3) the volume scales as A, and the nuclear density is approximately constant, which is the basis of the liquid drop model.
map.约 1.2 fm，不同拟合（含电荷半径/物质半径）略有差异。: About 1.2 fm, with slight differences between fits (including charge radius and matter radius).
map.→ 打开由质量数求核半径工具: -> Open the tool that finds the nuclear radius from the mass number
